query:
WITH nationality_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    hl.region,
    TRIM(hp.nationality) as nationality,
    COUNT(DISTINCT hp.id) as population
  FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala hp
  JOIN estishraf_llm_home_location hl ON hp.id = hl.id
  WHERE hp.is_in_population = TRUE 
    AND hp.snapshot = (SELECT MAX(snapshot) FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala)
    AND TRIM(hl.region) != '' AND hl.region IS NOT NULL
    AND hp.person_type = 'Alien'
  GROUP BY hl.region, TRIM(hp.nationality)
),
top_nationalities AS (
  SELECT 
    nationality,
    SUM(population) as total_population
  FROM nationality_counts
  GROUP BY nationality
  ORDER BY total_population DESC
  LIMIT 3
)
SELECT 
  nc.region,
  nc.nationality,
  nc.population
FROM nationality_counts nc
JOIN top_nationalities tn ON nc.nationality = tn.nationality
ORDER BY nc.region, nc.nationality
